data.crsp_daily: legacy crsp_a_stock.dsf (SIZ; ends 2024-12-31, same file as the phase-3 S1S3 pipeline) for every permno of a linked permco (any inst_type) or with a bank SIC (6020-6029, 6710-6712) in any dsenames row; rows 1995-01-03..2024-12-31 (cache/crsp_bank_dsf.parquet, 5,049,365 rows, 1,891 permnos). dsf_v2 (CIZ) is not used: legacy dsf carries prc / shrout / bid / ask / ret for 1995-2024 and matches the phase-3 pipeline; the task note 'CRSP ends 2024-12' is met.
data.crsp_names: crsp_a_stock.dsenames (namedt / nameendt validity; shrcd, exchcd, siccd = historical SIC of the name spell, permco)
data.market: crsp_a_stock.dsi vwretd (CRSP value-weighted, incl. distributions); trading calendar = dsi dates with non-null vwretd
data.factors: dump ff_all.fivefactors_monthly (mktrf smb hml rmw cma rf umd) for monthly alphas; ff_all.fivefactors_daily rf for the daily T-bill rate (S3)
data.link: bank_all.wrds_bank_crsp_link (rssd9001, permco, inst_type, dt_start, dt_end), 1,495 rows, dt_start 1986-06-30..2024-07-12, dt_end max 2024-09-30
data.sloos_release_dates: S1S3_sloos/out/release_dates_US_SLOOS.csv: release_date (exact, 1997+; missing for fred_date 1999-04-01, 2005-04-01, 2018-04-01), approx_release_regular_practice (used only where the spec says 'approx dates included')
data.eu: S3 repo universes stoxx600_eurozone_universe_2026-05-06 / stoxx600_uk_universe_2026-05-06 (membership spells from_date..thru, all spells honoured as in phase 3); daily prices phase-1 out/g_secd_stoxx600_min.parquet (prccd, ajexdi, trfd); regional calendars phase3/out/cal_{EZ,UK}.csv; GICS industry group = comp_global_daily.g_company.ggroup (current); caps = g_secd.stoxx600_2003plus prccd x cshoc near formation dates; FX = g_exrt_dly (GBP-based: exratd = units of tocurd per 1 GBP)
data.eu_surveys: EZ: out/release_dates_EZ_BLS.csv column wfnet (ECB BLS credit standards for loans to enterprises, weighted net percentage; the repo series behind shocks_ECB_BLS_OE_AR1) and release_date; UK: out/release_dates_UK_CCS.csv column neg_availability (BoE CCS corporate credit availability balance multiplied by -1, i.e. tightening positive) and release_date

fred_series.rule: IDs taken from the FRED search-results page for 'Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards' (logs/p4_00_fred_probe_a.log, _b, _c); a series is used only if its FRED series-page title starts with 'Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards for' (checked in logs/p4_01_fred.log, cache/fred_meta.csv). Excluded by construction: 'Large Domestic Banks' / 'Other Domestic Banks' subsets, the three loan-balance-weighted aggregates (SUBLPDMOSXWBNQ, SUBLPDMBSXWBNQ, SUBLPDMHSXWBNQ), demand (DRSDCILM) and willingness (DRIWCIL) series. Observations from fredgraph.csv (fetched 2026-11-21, header research-reverify/1.0); FRED observation date = first day of the survey quarter = fred_date of the release table.

not_used.why: title passes ('... Consumer Loans Excluding Credit Card Loans (DISCONTINUED)', 1996-01-01..2011-01-01) but it duplicates DRTSCOCL (max |difference| 0.1 pp over 61 common quarters); averaging both would double-count one category

title 'Net Percentage of Banks Tightening Standards for Mortgage Loans (DISCONTINUED)', 1990-07-01..2007-01-01: fails the title rule ('of Banks', not 'of Domestic Banks'); not used. Consequence: no RRE series exists for surveys before 2007-04-01 -> RRE is dropped and the other shares renormalised (spec rule) for releases with fred_date <= 2007-01-01

category_N.CRE: fred_date <= 2013-07-01: DRTSCREL; fred_date >= 2013-10-01: mean of SUBLPDRCSC, SUBLPDRCSN, SUBLPDRCSM available at fred_date (spec: construction / nonfarm nonresidential / multifamily from 2013Q4)
category_N.RRE: mean of the RRE-category series available at fred_date: none before 2007-04-01 (category dropped); 2007-04-01..2014-10-01 DRTSPM, DRTSNT, DRTSSP (+ SUBLPDCLHSNQ from 2008-01-01); 2015-01-01+ the six 2015-classification series + DRTSSP + SUBLPDCLHSNQ. HELOCs are included because the spec's RRE loan share contains HELOC balances (BHDM1797)
category_N.OC: fred_date <= 2011-01-01: DRTSCOCL (consumer excl. credit card = auto + other consumer); fred_date >= 2011-04-01: mean(STDSAUTO, STDSOTHCONS) available
category_N.missing_category_rule: a category with no available series at fred_date is dropped; each bank's remaining shares are divided by their sum (spec). A bank whose available-category share sum is 0 is excluded at that release

y9c.duplicates: some (rssd9001, rssd9999) keys appear more than once with different wrdsdownloaddate (bhck_1 / bhck_2 1,112 keys, other_1 29,305 keys, mostly 2022-2025). Per file keep one row per key: the row with a non-null key item (bhck_1: bhck1763 or bhck1766; bhck_2: bhck2170; other_1: bhdm1797), earliest wrdsdownloaddate first (closest to real time); the number of keys whose kept and dropped rows differ is logged
y9c.filer_row: a bank-quarter is usable iff bhck2170 (total assets) > 0 and the five-category loan total > 0

items.CI: bhck1763 + bhck1764 (missing bhck1764 counted 0) when bhck1763 is present; else bhck1766 (C&I total; equals 1763+1764 in 99.997% of 103,274 rows with all three; from 2019 about 550 filers per year report only bhck1766)
items.CRE: construction = bhckf158 + bhckf159 when either is present (2007-03-31+), else bhdm1415 (ends 2007-12-31; 2007 overlap median ratio 1.000) + multifamily bhdm1460 + nonfarm nonresidential = bhckf160 + bhckf161 when either is present, else bhdm1480 (spec)
items.CC: bhckb538 from 2001-03-31 (spec). SUBSTITUTION for 2000-03-31..2000-12-31 reports: bhck2008 ('credit cards and related plans', valid 1991-03-31..2000-12-31; it also contains other revolving credit that bhckb539 later separates)
items.OC: 2011-03-31+: bhckb539 + bhckk137 + bhckk207; 2001-03-31..2010-12-31: bhckb539 + bhck2011 (spec); SUBSTITUTION 2000 reports: bhck2011 only (other revolving credit is inside bhck2008 = CC that year). Identity checks: CC+OC = bhck1975 in 99.87% (2001-10) and 99.997% (2011+) of rows
items.missing_and_negative: within a usable filer row a missing component item is set to 0 (Y-9C blanks = not applicable); negative component values are set to 0; counts of both are logged. Shares = component / five-category total, so they sum to 1 by construction (asserted to 1e-9)
items.controls: book equity = bhck3210 - bhck3283 (missing 3283 -> 0; <= 0 -> missing B/M); total loans bhck2122 for 3-year loan growth; total assets bhck2170 for link tie-breaks

y9c.lag_75d: for release r, q*(r) = latest calendar quarter-end q with (r - q) >= 75 calendar days. The bank uses its report dated q*(r); if absent, its latest report dated within the two quarters before q*(r) (q*(r) - 183 days <= rssd9999 < q*(r)); else it has no signal at r. The dump starts 2000-03-31, so the first S1 release is the August 2000 survey release

us_universe.link: link rows with lower(inst_type) == 'bank holding company' (1,223 rows; 'commercial bank', 'thrift holding company' and other types excluded: spec says BHC). Valid at r iff dt_start <= r <= dt_end, where dt_end equal to the table maximum (2024-09-30, the table's last update; 281 rows) is treated as open-ended (still linked through 2024-12-31)
us_universe.common_stock: permnos of the permco with a dsenames spell valid at r (namedt <= r <= nameendt) with shrcd in {10, 11} and exchcd in {1, 2, 3}; if several, the one with the largest market cap at the price date (spec)
us_universe.price_date: S1: close of r (last CRSP record <= r, at most 5 trading days stale). S2: close of the last trading day before day 0 (same staleness rule) so that the screen does not condition on the event-window return
us_universe.filters: |prc| >= $5 and market cap = |prc| x shrout x 1000 >= $100M at the price date (spec). 'No filter' variant drops both
us_universe.ties: one rssd valid for several permcos at r -> keep the permco whose selected permno has the larger cap; one permco linked to several rssd at r -> S1 keeps the rssd with the larger bhck2170 in its Y-9C report used at r; S2 keeps the permco once
us_universe.S2_pre2000: release dates r < 2000-01-01 (1997-1999): bank = CRSP common stock (shrcd 10/11, exchcd 1/2/3) whose dsenames siccd valid at r is in 6020-6029 or 6710-6712, same price / cap screen, one permno per permco (largest cap). Spec rule as written (its premise 'the link table does not reach before 2000' is false for this table: dt_start goes back to 1986). Second reading, declared now and reported only (not used for the verdict): the link-table universe for all years including 1997-1999 (S2_alt_link_all_years)

returns.daily: legacy dsf ret; missing ret or ret < -1 (missing codes) -> 0; prc negative = bid/ask midpoint -> |prc|
returns.delisting: dsedelist records with dlstcd >= 200 appended as an extra return at max(dlstdt, last dsf date + 1 day); missing dlret with dlstcd 500-599 -> -0.30 if exchcd in {1,2}, -0.55 if exchcd 3 (Shumway 1997; Shumway-Warther 1999); other missing -> 0. After its last record a position is held in cash (0%) to the period end (phase-3 rule)
returns.holding_return: simple buy-and-hold R = I(exit)/I(entry) - 1 on the total-return index I; entry value = last record <= entry date (at most 5 trading days stale, else the stock cannot be bought and is excluded); exit value = last record <= exit date

S1.releases: rebalance dates = US SLOOS releases with an exact release_date, q*(r) >= 2000-03-31, r <= 2024-12-31. Releases without an exact date (1999-04-01, 2005-04-01, 2018-04-01 surveys) are not rebalance points: the previous portfolio is held to the next exact release (spec: 'exact release date'). Approximate dates are not used in S1
S1.timing: t0(r) = first CRSP trading day strictly after r. Formation and entry at close of t0(r) (spec: next trading day close); exit at close of t0(r_next), r_next = next rebalance release. Only complete periods (exit <= 2024-12-31) are used; the period starting at the 2024-11-12 release is dropped
S1.signal: BT(i,r) = sum_k share'(i,k) x N(k,r), share' = shares renormalised over the categories available at r (spec). N(k,r) = category value at the release's fred_date
S1.sample: banks in the S1 universe at r (link-valid BHC common stock, filters at close of r) with a Y-9C signal and a valid entry at t0(r)
S1.quintiles: per formation date, rank BT ascending (ties by permno), quintile = ceil(5 x rank / n). LONG = quintile 1 (lowest BT), SHORT = quintile 5 (highest BT). A period needs n >= 25; otherwise dropped (count logged)
S1.main_stat: L/S_p = EW mean R(LONG) - EW mean R(SHORT) per holding period; statistic = time-series mean over periods, t from OLS on a constant with Newey-West HAC, 1 lag (statsmodels cov_type HAC, maxlags 1, default small-sample correction). Expected sign positive
S1.verdict: PHASE4 protocol section 3 with spec section 4: holds iff t >= 2.24 (two-sided Bonferroni 5%/2, expected sign) and both halves have a positive mean; weak iff expected sign and 1.96 <= t < 2.24, or t >= 2.24 with one half negative; otherwise not holding. A significant negative result is reported separately, not as holding. Reference: exact critical t.ppf(1 - 0.0125, n - 1) also printed

report_also.VW: value weights = market cap at the formation close, same legs
report_also.no_filter: same construction without the $5 / $100M screens (quintiles re-formed in that universe)
report_also.calendar_monthly: daily leg value V(t) = EW mean of I_i(t)/I_i(entry) within each holding period (buy-and-hold weights); daily leg return chained across periods; monthly leg return = product of daily (1+r) in the calendar month; monthly L/S = monthly LONG - monthly SHORT; months from the first formation month to the last exit month; regression on FF5 + UMD monthly (mktrf smb hml rmw cma umd), intercept t Newey-West 6 lags (phase-3 monthly convention)
report_also.fama_macbeth: per period cross-section of the S1 sample: R_i ~ z(BT) + log(market cap, $M) + B/M + past 12-month return + 3-year loan growth. z(BT) = within-period standardised BT; B/M = book equity ($000) / market cap ($000) at formation; past return = I(t0)/I(t0 - 252 trading days) - 1 (both ends within 5 trading days stale, else missing); loan growth = ln(bhck2122_q / bhck2122_{q-12 quarters}) for the bank's Y-9C quarter q used (exact q-12 report required). B/M, past return and loan growth winsorised at the 1st / 99th within-period percentiles. Version B adds the raw (not renormalised) shares CI, CRE, CC, OC (RRE omitted base). Observations with any missing regressor dropped; periods with < 30 observations skipped. Coefficient time-series mean with Newey-West 1-lag t. Expected z(BT) sign negative
report_also.leg_shares: mean over periods of the leg-mean raw shares and renormalised shares (5 categories), LONG and SHORT
report_also.counts: per period: linked BHC common stocks valid at r, with Y-9C signal, after screens, with valid entry, per quintile; by year
report_also.costs: half-spread hs = (ask - bid)/((ask + bid)/2)/2 from CRSP closing bid/ask on the trade date (last record <= date, at most 5 trading days stale), valid iff 0 < bid <= ask and relative spread < 0.5, else the median hs of the same leg on that date, else 0.25%. PRIMARY (turnover, PHASE3 section 3): at each rebalance close each leg trades |w_new - w_old_drifted| per name at that name's hs (cash from delisted names trades free); first entry buys the full leg, the last exit sells the full leg; cost booked to the period being entered (final liquidation to the last period). Short borrow 1% per year on the short leg x calendar days / 365 (spec). BOUND (full round trip): every position pays hs at entry and at exit each period. Net L/S = gross - long cost - short cost - borrow; mean and NW(1) t for both

S2.events: US SLOOS releases with an exact release_date, release year 1997-2024, day +1 <= 2024-12-31 (spec)
S2.surprise: s(r) = DRTSCILM(fred_date of r) - DRTSCILM(previous quarterly observation) in pp (spec), regressor s/10
S2.days: day 0 = first CRSP trading day >= r (release day; SLOOS is published intraday), day +1 = next trading day
S2.bank_portfolio: members fixed at the pre-window close (see us_universe); daily EW mean over members with a dsf record that day (missing ret -> member skipped that day); a delisting return dated day 0 or +1 is compounded into that member's day return. VW variant: weights = market cap at the pre-window close
S2.AR: AR_t = bank portfolio return - vwretd (dsi); CAR[0,+1] = AR_0 + AR_1 (sum), in %
S2.main_stat: OLS CAR[0,+1] = a + b (s/10) + e, White HC0 t on b. Expected sign negative. Verdict as S1 with the sign reversed (b <= -2.24 and both halves negative)

report_also.VW: VW bank portfolio CAR[0,+1] on s/10
report_also.market: vwretd_0 + vwretd_1 on s/10 (two-sided, no expected sign)
report_also.ar1_surprise: u(r) = y_q - (a + rho y_{q-1}), a / rho from OLS on DRTSCILM quarterly observations from 1990-04-01 up to the quarter before q (expanding, data known before r); CAR[0,+1] on u/10
report_also.terciles: events ranked by s(r) (ties by date) into three equal-size groups (pd.qcut on rank); mean CAR[0,+1] and its t in the bottom and top tercile, top - bottom difference with Welch t
report_also.alt_link_all_years: second reading of the pre-2000 bank definition (see us_universe.S2_pre2000); main regression only

aux_EZ_UK.bank_id: g_company.ggroup == '4010' (current GICS; available for the universe gvkeys, so the spec condition 'bank identification directly from Compustat Global GICS 4010' is met)
aux_EZ_UK.EZ_universe: PRIMARY: repo 'eurozone' universe restricted to listings whose g_company loc is a euro-area country (AUT BEL CYP DEU ESP EST FIN FRA GRC HRV IRL ITA LTU LUX LVA MLT NLD PRT SVK SVN); the repo file is in fact STOXX 600 ex-UK (CHE, SWE, DNK, NOR, POL ... listings) and the BLS surveys euro-area banks only. SECOND READING (declared now, reported only): the repo universe as used in phase 3 ('EZ_broad')
aux_EZ_UK.events: releases with release_date, EZ 2003-2024, UK 2007-2024 (same years as S3; US CRSP ends 2024)
aux_EZ_UK.surprise: EZ: wfnet(r) - wfnet(previous survey row); UK: neg_availability(r) - neg_availability(previous row) (tightening positive, spec); regressor /10
aux_EZ_UK.returns: daily total return = adj_t / adj_prev - 1 with adj = prccd x trfd / ajexdi, previous record at most 5 regional trading days earlier, |log return| >= 1.5 dropped (phase-3 cleaning); membership at r (from_date <= r <= thru); banks EW minus all-member EW, day 0 = first regional trading day >= r, day +1 next; local currency

S3.status: reference only, not in the verdict (spec section 3)
S3.US_periods: (a) 1997-2024: exact-date releases (as S1, no Y-9C condition), period = close t0(r) .. close t0(r_next), complete periods only; (b) 1990-2024: all releases from fred_date 1990-04-01 with exact date else approx_release_regular_practice (spec: approximate dates included); (c) 2015-2024: the (a) periods with release year 2015-2024
S3.US_excess: period excess return = prod(1 + vwretd) - prod(1 + rf_daily) over trading days in (t0, t0_next], rf = ff_all.fivefactors_daily rf, in %
S3.US_regression: excess_p on DRTSCILM(r_p) level (%), OLS slope, Newey-West 1-lag t (spec)
S3.OOS_R2: expanding window: forecast for period p from OLS on all earlier completed periods of the same definition (their returns are known at the start of p); benchmark = mean of the same earlier returns; first forecast after 20 training periods for (a) and (b); (c) evaluates 2015-2024 periods with training on all earlier (a) periods from 1997. R2_OS = 1 - SSE(model)/SSE(mean) (Campbell-Thompson 2008 definition). The CT-restricted version (forecast set to the historical mean when the slope is positive, i.e. not the expected negative sign, and truncated at 0 when negative) is also reported, both readings of 'Campbell-Thompson' declared now
S3.timing: in equity (CRSP VW) over period p iff DRTSCILM(r_p) <= median of all DRTSCILM observations from 1990-04-01 through r_p's survey (expanding, inclusive), else T-bill (daily rf). Daily strategy and buy-and-hold excess returns over the evaluated periods; Sharpe = mean / sd of daily excess x sqrt(252); annualised mean excess = 252 x mean. Evaluated over (a), (b), (c) periods
S3.EU: EZ (2003-2024, BLS release dates, level wfnet) and UK (2007-2024, CCS dates, level neg_availability): periods between consecutive release dates on the regional calendar (close of first regional trading day after r .. same after r_next); value-weighted return of members at r with weights = prccd x cshoc at the last record within 10 calendar days <= formation date, converted to EUR (EZ) / GBP (UK) with g_exrt_dly; buy-and-hold within the period; RF = 0 (stated, spec); same regression (NW 1), OOS R2 (min 20 training periods) and timing (in market iff level <= expanding median of all earlier-and-current levels in the table, else cash at 0%). EZ primary = euro-area-country universe, EZ_broad = repo universe (second reading, declared now)

inference_common.bonferroni: 2 primary tests (S1, S2 US): |t| >= 2.24 (two-sided 5%/2, normal 2.2414) as written in the spec; exact df-based critical values printed for reference

outputs.s1_bank_table: out/s1_bank_table.parquet: per release x bank: release_date, t0, exit, permno, permco, rssd9001, y9c_date, shares (raw, 5) and renormalised (5), BT, quintile, holding return, mcap, prc, controls
outputs.s1_N: out/s1_N_by_release.csv: N(k, r) for the five categories and series counts
outputs.s1_ls: out/s1_ls_periods.csv: per period gross L/S EW / VW / no-filter, leg returns, counts, costs, net
outputs.s2_events: out/s2_events.csv: per event AR_0, AR_1, CAR (EW, VW), market, s, u, n banks

deviations.when: after the first S2 run (logs/p4_30_s2.log first version), before S3 was run
